Prior to this term, as the engine originated with Pocket Edition, this entire product family was referred to as "Pocket Edition", "MCPE", or "Pocket/Windows 10 Edition".

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash

apk add --no-cache curl jq unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" ] || [ "${BEDROCK_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "Downloading latest Bedrock server"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -sL -A "Mozilla/5.0" https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links | jq -r '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType=="serverBedrockLinux") | .downloadUrl')
else 
    echo "Downloading ${BEDROCK_VERSION} Bedrock server"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${BEDROCK_VERSION}.zip"
fi

DOWNLOAD_FILE="bedrock-server.zip"

echo "Downloading files from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -sSL -A "Mozilla/5.0" -o "${DOWNLOAD_FILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

echo "Unpacking server files"
unzip -o "${DOWNLOAD_FILE}"
rm -f "${DOWNLOAD_FILE}"

echo 'emit-server-telemetry=true' >> server.properties

chmod +x bedrock_server

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
